title: Write test writing guide for this codebase
description:
Write docs/testing.md: the test oracle policy (no self-validation), how to write test vectors correctly, when to use unit vs integration vs interop tests, how to run the full interop suite, how to add a new interop test case. Artifact: docs/testing.md.

Acceptance criteria: covers test oracle policy explicitly; explains how to derive test vectors from openssl/python/kubo; includes a worked example of adding a new NNTP conformance test
